title: Cross-Team Data Flow, Handoff Protocol, and Quality Gates (v2)
changelog: v2: Added gatherer-to-sorter handoff protocol (identified as largest gap by TT-OBS-1), quality gates between pipeline stages, batch manifest schema, and load-balanced sorter assignment
improvements_over_v1: Added formal gatherer-to-sorter handoff protocol (v1 had none — largest identified gap)
Added quality gates between pipeline stages with minimum thresholds
Added batch manifest schema for structured handoffs
Added load-balanced sorter assignment via WorkStealing (v1 was static)
Added deduplication step using fingerprinting from think_tank.py
Added cross-validation stage where think tanks periodically validate flowing data

section_1_handoff_protocol.title: Gatherer-to-Sorter Handoff Protocol
section_1_handoff_protocol.description: Defines how data gatherers package and hand off data to sorter/archiver teams.

batch_manifest_schema.description: Every handoff must include a manifest that describes the batch.

dedup_hashes: array of content fingerprints for dedup

handoff_steps.details: Create manifest JSON with all items and quality metadata
Score must be >= 0.6 (60% B+ threshold). If below, gatherer must improve or discard low-quality items before handoff.

handoff_steps.rationale: Higher quality batches get sorted first

handoff_steps.details: Reject batches missing required fields. Return to gatherer with error details.
Compare content_hash against previously archived items. Use think_tank._fingerprint() for consistency.
Place items in appropriate knowledge-base/entries/ or storage/ locations per taxonomy

section_2_quality_gates.title: Quality Gates Between Pipeline Stages
section_2_quality_gates.description: Data must pass quality checks to move between stages. Prevents garbage-in-garbage-out.

checks: Item count matches actual items array length
Content hashes computed for all items
gates.fail_action: Gatherer fixes issues and resubmits. Batch does NOT enter sort queue.

checks: Items categorized against standard taxonomy (SOP-016 v1 taxonomy)
No duplicates against existing archive (< 80% content similarity)
KB entry format compliance (if destined for knowledge-base/)
gates.fail_action: Sorter fixes categorization or dedup issues. Items NOT archived until passing.

gates.frequency: Every 30 minutes or every 50 items archived, whichever comes first
checks: Random sample of 5 archived items for accuracy
No systematic quality degradation (compare recent vs earlier batches)
Cross-team consistency (items from different gatherers on same topic should align)
gates.fail_action: Think tank flags specific issues. Gatherers/sorters receive corrective feedback via bus.

section_3_load_balanced_sorter_assignmen.title: Load-Balanced Sorter Assignment
section_3_load_balanced_sorter_assignmen.description: Replaces static 1:1 gatherer-to-sorter mapping with dynamic queue-based assignment.

backpressure.action: Notify coordinator; slow gatherer output or add temporary sorter agents
backpressure.extreme_action: Pause all gatherers until queue drains to < 3

note: The full v1 content (report standardization, consolidation pipeline, data flow rules, findings taxonomy) remains valid and is inherited. This v2 adds the handoff/quality layer.
